'''Valoy''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] guardsman who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Republic Expeditionary Forces|Expeditionary Forces]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Valoy was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], a planet that was [[Destruction of Taris|ravaged]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]] three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before. He and a research expedition went with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] to take pollution readings and display further evidence on the [[Rakghoul]] [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]]. After Master Tykan disappeared, Valoy contacted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nelex]] to request backup until he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the mission.
